messages:
Maya: Quick async check-in — SDK quickstarts + sample app status. What I did / blockers / today.

Maya: Done: Drafted Python quickstart + example app, pushed PR #542. Added CI snippet and minimal env notes.

Maya: Notes in PR: uses new client init `from redwood import Client` and example call. Needs review for credential guidance.

Maya: Quick commands I included: 
```
pip install redwood-inference
python -m redwood_quickstart run --model redwood-alpha
```

Thomas: Taking PR #542 for review today, should get to it this afternoon. 

Thomas: Question — do we want to recommend the `REDWOOD_API_KEY` approach or prefer `~/.redwood/credentials` for the quickstarts?

Maya: For quickstarts I'd prefer env var first (simpler), mention creds file as next step for power users. Added a short blurb in the PR but open to wording.

Jess: Quick heads up — hit an error in the TypeScript quickstart when running `yarn start` in the sample app: 
```
Error: Cannot find module 'esbuild'
```
I think package.json missed esbuild as devDep.

Alex: Thanks Jess — I'll patch the samplekit. I'll add esbuild + a short note about node >=16.14.0 and update the README.

Alex: Also will add env example `.env.example` with REDWOOD_API_KEY so newcomers don't miss it.

Jess: Nice, thanks. After that I can re-run the quickstart smoke tests. :thumbsup:

Sam: FYI I'm blocked on deploying the sample app to staging because I need staging kube creds from infra. Pinged infra channel.

Maya: Marking the staging deployment as optional for the quickstart; main priority is docs + runnable local sample. Sam — once you have creds we can add the one-click deploy section.

Thomas: Small docs nit: in SDK reference the `Client.generate()` example returns a bare string in the code block but our actual client returns a dict with `text` and `tokens`. Maybe adjust example to match runtime.

Maya: Good catch. I'll sync the example to match `{'text': ..., 'tokens': ...}` and add a comment about streaming vs non-streaming.

doc-bot: AUTOLINK: Updated internal doc link -> https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/quickstarts/python (edited 1778890200).

Maya: Can reviewers please drop quick comments on PR #542 and flag any API mismatch? No need for long reviews — focus on correctness of examples and clarity for first-time users.

Thomas: Will do. ETA EOD.

Alex: I'll push the samplekit patch in ~30m and link the PR here.

Jess: After that I'll re-run smoke and post results.

Maya: Thanks team — if anyone hits a blocker ping me or drop a quick message here. If no blockers we aim to merge the docs + sample updates tomorrow. :rocket:
